tasks.title: Robust Grid and Subgrid across every page
reviewer_roles: Codex, independent layout and accessibility review
tasks.scope: Dedicated future prototype and technical-design session. Production and schema authority remain with the existing work orders and James.
deliverables: Complete page and state inventory covering every room sheet, standalone typology study, Workbench Frame and linked design-library page. Missing V-01/V-02 sources are explicit inventory gaps, not silent exclusions.
Layout contract per page kind: named regions, container-driven breakpoints, track ownership, and title/content/status subgrid alignment. Preserve distinct typology skeletons and verbs.
Responsive prototype pass across all available pages and their expanded, collapsed, empty, error and loading states. Replace fragile inline overrides with explicit layout structure in the derivative.
Coverage matrix with page-level overflow results, aligned-band checks, screenshots and accessibility-tree comparisons.
acceptance: Every available page has a recorded layout/state review at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 pixels, plus short landscape.
Long labels, realistic counts, larger text and 200% zoom do not clip work or obscure controls.
No page-wide horizontal overflow; intentional diagram/table scrolling is bounded, reachable and explained.
Subgrid alignment holds after expansion, filtering, sidebar changes and page entry. Related status bands remain aligned.
Validate Chrome, Safari and Firefox behavior and document fallbacks for unsupported layout/motion features.
Keep keyboard focus and reading order meaningful through every reflow.

tasks.title: Navigation controls and room-to-sheet state
reviewer_roles: Claude Design, flow and control review
tasks.scope: Dedicated future prototype and technical-design session. Production and schema authority remain with the existing work orders and James.
deliverables: Interaction and state model for tour, selected block, room flight, finder, dashboard, sheet tabs, room switcher, cancellation, return and browser Back.
Control redesign with touch, keyboard and direct-page equivalents. Preview/focus must remain distinct from opening a sheet.
Explicit entry-block, bookmark, scroll-progress and draft-lifetime contracts. Derive destinations from the clicked block; Drafting Table must not force the lobby.
End-to-end navigation check that starts at a block, edits a mock sheet, switches sheets/rooms, returns, resumes scrolling and exercises Back.
acceptance: Finder and sheet tabs work without a pointer; all controls have useful names and reachable focus.
Escape, Back and stop have defined behavior inside and outside an iframe. Focus restoration does not scroll the document.
Test small scroll deltas, both page boundaries, rapid repeated activation, interrupted flights and no-WebGL entry.
Room and sheet switching preserve drafts according to the agreed contract, with visible consequences if a draft cannot be retained.
Phone controls remain usable with the virtual keyboard, orientation change and safe-area insets.
A person can reach every page without completing the cinematic tour.

tasks.title: Motion and transformation build for cards, sheets and house pieces
reviewer_roles: Claude Design, choreography and typology review
tasks.scope: Dedicated future prototype and technical-design session. Production and schema authority remain with the existing work orders and James.
deliverables: Transition inventory covering Grid/Subgrid expansion, card transformation, finder preview, room flight, dashboard entry/exit, room switching and scroll resumption.
Motion specifications with a single owner per transition, easing/acceleration, interruption rules, transform origins, snapshot clipping and focus/live-region behavior.
Comparison of native View Transitions and transform/opacity approaches. Use R4 Typology Identity v2 and Workbench Frame as measured precedents.
Assembly-path audit for wall/roof courses, stairs/supports and tree pieces, plus a comfortable simplified camera route.
acceptance: No hover lift/scale or adjacent-room opacity shifts that alter perceived depth.
No stretched or unreadable text snapshots during layout transforms.
No abrupt starts, whip turns or unowned overlap between scroll and room-flight animation.
Pieces approach along plausible attachment paths, align before seating and avoid visible body intersections.
Provide explicit reduced-motion behavior for each transition and an equivalent direct route.
Test forward/backward scroll, interruption and reversal across all layout widths, including short landscape.

tasks.title: Efficient render structure before production
tasks.owner_role: Claude Code, dedicated render research session

deliverables: Compare current GLB hierarchy, static geometry batching, instanced repeated parts and invalidation-driven rendering while preserving block/course/tree/stair picking and assembly identities.
Record CPU/GPU frame time, draw calls, decode time and memory on representative integrated GPUs and phones with matched viewports and camera paths.

Recommendations retain the reviewed model quality and animation identities.
Document context-loss recovery and adaptive pixel-ratio/detail choices.
